response:
关闭「启用补充明细」时，明细输入框会隐藏，但 `$detail` 仍保留“保留内容”这一值，并且不参与必填校验；名称始终必填。点击按钮只会生成一份可编辑的检查草稿，供你确认后自行发送，不会自动提交。

```kelivo-ui
ui 1 catalog "kelivo.native/1"
root = Column(children=[form,ask])
$on: boolean = false
$name: string = ""
$detail: string = "保留内容"
form = Form(children=[toggle,nameField,detailField], title="补充意见")
toggle = Switch(bind=$on, label="启用补充明细")
nameField = TextField(bind=$name, label="名称", required=true)
detailField = TextField(bind=$detail, label="明细", required=true, visible=$on)
ask = Button(label="准备检查草稿", form=form, action=Ask(text="请检查这份补充意见表单的填写内容，指出需要补充或澄清的地方。", context={"name":$name,"enabled":$on,"detail":$detail}))
```
